name: Playback Chip
description: The Playback Chip is the audit loop on the CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip: paste your own output about the CWI catalog and get back a scored, annotated playback — every claim checked against the verified fact set with per-sentence verdicts (VERIFIED / DEVIATION / UNVERIFIABLE / CLAIM-FLAG / DENIED) and a fidelity score 0–100. JS port of playback.py, parity-tested. White-label: equip it, re-skin it, ship it in your own stack.
data_truth: MIXED — fact set LIVE, demo inputs SAMPLE
truth_detail: MIXED. Fact set (playback.json) is LIVE: indexed from the CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip, observed 2026-09-15, with per-claim citations. The two 'Load SAMPLE' demo buttons inject simulated demo text, honestly labeled in the UI, never presented as real. UNVERIFIABLE is a verdict, not a pass.
